title: A group's forge adapter, named as extension point forge, answers every merge request and pipeline read made through a repository root, as land and stalled make
goal: bl_forge.arm(root) returns the adapter extensions.forge names, built as Adapter(target, run, cwd); with no extensions.forge arm returns the glab or gh arm the forge setting picks as now; extending.md lists the forge point's methods request, pipelines, pipeline, jobs, trace, set_description and merge with their return shapes; bl_forge.read_request returns the adapter's request answer

clauses.clause: bl_forge.arm(root) returns the adapter extensions.forge names, built as Adapter(target, run, cwd)
with no extensions.forge arm returns the glab or gh arm the forge setting picks as now
extending.md lists the forge point's methods request, pipelines, pipeline, jobs, trace, set_description and merge with their return shapes
bl_forge.read_request returns the adapter's request answer

gates.question: Where does arm find the forge adapter: only extensions.forge, or also the entry point of group it_ops_kb.forge that kbext.load falls back to?
options: extensions.forge or the it_ops_kb.forge entry point, as kbext.load finds it
gates.recommendation: extensions.forge or the it_ops_kb.forge entry point, as kbext.load finds it
gates.reason: the one lookup rule every point has
gates.answer: extensions.forge or the it_ops_kb.forge entry point, as kbext.load finds it

gates.question: When extensions.forge names an adapter that cannot be loaded, does arm fall back to glab or gh or refuse?
options: refuse with Rejected carrying kbext's one line, exit 2
fall back to the glab or gh arm
gates.recommendation: refuse with Rejected carrying kbext's one line, exit 2
gates.reason: a quiet fall back would read the wrong forge
gates.answer: refuse with Rejected carrying kbext's one line, exit 2

gates.question: Which callers does the forge adapter answer: those reading through arm(root) only, or url_arm too (the query log's delivery and the CI detector, which have a url and no root)?
options: arm(root) only; url_arm keeps reading the url's own forge
gates.recommendation: arm(root) only; url_arm keeps reading the url's own forge
gates.reason: the goal names land, stalled and red-pipeline, and url_arm has no root to find a settings layer from
gates.answer: arm(root) only; url_arm keeps reading the url's own forge
